declarations.name: Lemma F1. Logarithmic derivative correspondence
declarations.scope: For one nonidentity arbitrary factor lambda with k parts and s>=2 literal single cycles of lengths q_i, k=1+sum(q_i-1), logarithmic derivative df/f identifies the labeled-root polynomial space modulo target scaling with the genus0 fixed-residue fiber H(q_i-1,-1^(k+1)) at residues(lambda,-N). Positivity proves nonresonance for every integer lambda, including equal/common-divisor parts. The distinct-critical-value locus deletes a proper algebraic divisor and preserves components.

declarations.name: Theorem F2. Complete component criterion for the single-cycle tail
declarations.scope: For every such passport, full braid components number exactly two iff all q_i are odd and lambda has distinct parts, and one otherwise. Imports actual CGPT2026 Theorem1.7 and its Lemma8.1/Lemma8.6 boundary arguments. Equal-order zero labels preserve surgical parity; a transposition of equal-residue roots flips it. Thus this parity is a sufficient geometric component label after the precise label quotients. It is not automatically a reduced lift for the actual finite monodromy group.

declarations.name: Theorem F3. Exact monodromy, every block system, and trivial deck
declarations.scope: For every one-arbitrary-factor/single-cycle-tail passport with s>=2, all block-count divisors are div(D) union{N}, D=gcd(lambda). The identical actual embedded group for all tuples is Alt_n^D<P_N> if every tail length is odd, and S_n wr C_D otherwise, n=N/D. Orders, trivial deck and primitive An/Sn specializations follow. Return budget forces every tail inside one block, phases on the incidence tree construct all blocks, and a commutator of aligned tail cycles gives a3cycle whose normal supports give the alternating direct product.
